description: Operator, one-shot: backfill Director land records for lanes that landed on main before cs land reported them. Walks main's history for Land lane/<name>, legacy lane <name>: …, and Merge branch 'lane/<name>' commits; matches the newest finished job for that repo and lane finished before each commit; posts state: landed with a stable Idempotency-Key per run and commit. --dry-run prints without posting. Not a model tool.

dry_run.description: Print what would be posted without calling the Director.
